description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.user with system.user.editUser, or addUser when the gateway has no user of that name and refresh the data.users binding. When present, event.password is a staged password to apply (u.set('password', ...)) — it appears ONLY when config.allowPasswordChange is enabled; handle it deliberately and never log it. Capability flags only hide UI: a crafted client can send this event with any payload, so check the session user's roles and re-read the flags here on the gateway before writing (see the adminAuth reference library). isNew is only a UI hint a crafted client can set to anything: work out whether a save creates from gateway data (system.user.getUser).

user.description: The full desired user as the flat PyUser mirror: username, firstName, lastName, schedule, language, notes, roles[], contactInfo[] (blank rows dropped), scheduleAdjustments[] ({start, end, available, note} — rebuild wholesale via system.user.createScheduleAdjustment).

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow. A UI hint only, so don't decide what to write from it: work out whether the save creates from gateway data. Use it only to report a conflict instead of overwriting a user that already has this name.

password.description: Present only when a password was staged (config.allowPasswordChange). Apply via u.set('password', ...) in the persistence script; subject to the user source's complexity policy.
